label: Stage-two spine rivals audited against the substantive objection standard
summary: Audit of the 24 stage-two rows of the modal spine rival table (10 root and act-of-being premises, 14 attribute and naming premises consumed by NecessaryClassicalGodRoot.derive and NecessaryClassicalGodRootFromUnderived.derive) against the substantive objection standard of 2026-11-12. Each rival already has a finite model in which it holds with the other premises of its consuming theorem and that theorem's conclusion fails (results of specs/spine-rivals-root-esse.toml and specs/spine-rivals-attributes.toml). Those models show where each premise is needed; they are not evidence against it, and the note's column semantics were corrected to say so. Method: for each rival, check the corpus for a sourced claim, verified result or read source that justifies its mechanism, and whether that mechanism bears on the premise as formalized; symmetrically, list the claims stating the premise and its derivations. No source was newly read; leads named below are from memory or from registered but unread sources, and carry no weight. Findings (full table in docs/notes/modal-spine.md, section 'Stage two: objection audit'). SUBSTANTIVE OR PARTIAL (9): (1) whole-roster nontrapping vs infinitism: Welchance 2026 (read, passage WELCHANCE-INFINITISM-1-3) argues parity of an unexplained chain with an unexplained foundation; open bridges: his relata are facts under 'in virtue of', and he concludes parity, not truth. (2, 3) the esse-cause and simple-priority concreteness bridges vs Platonic causes: claim PLATO-PHAEDO-100D-PARTICIPATION-EXPLANATORY and Rosen's report of Lewis's events-as-sets (claim SEP-ABSTRACT-OBJECTS-32-LEWIS-EVENTS-ARE-SETS); open bridges: explaining being so is not causing esse or simple priority, and impure sets are not shown non-concrete. (4) grades to a maximum: comparatives without a maximum are an established mathematical fact, so the premise needs a warrant specific to being; no case of unbounded grades of being is on file. (5) uniting cause vs priority monism: Schaffer (claim SCHAFFER-14-BASIC-WHOLE) gives a basic composite whose parts depend on it, contesting the q.3 a.7 reason; open bridge: ungrounded is not uncaused in being. (6) immaterial-intellect: the recorded physicalist rival is partial (Papineau causal-power physicalism, claim PAPINEAU-RISE-CAUSAL-POWERS-PHYSICAL; bridge physical to matter-form composite open), but a stronger objection on file is not yet a recorded rival: Plotinus V.4.2 (claim PLOTINUS-V4-INTELLECT-NOT-FIRST) argues intellect is two, so the absolutely simple first is not intellect; it targets the joint simplicity and intellect conclusions and is the most consequential stage-two objection found. (7) act's priority: Aristotle's aporia, Met. XII.6 1071b22-28 (claim ARIST-MET-1071B-POTENCY-PRIOR-A), answered in the same passage. (8) naming: the rival is derived from the unattributed practice-use thesis WF-P1, supported but not stated by Phillips's secondhand-reported remark (claim SEP-RELIGIOUS-LANGUAGE-4-1-PHILLIPS-NO-OBJECT-A). (9) sufficiency: a stipulated bridge to the primitive HasClassicalAttributes field; Dei Filius ch. 1 (claim VATICAN-I-DEI-FILIUS-CH1-ONE-TRUE-LIVING-GOD) lists members not derived from the nine (almighty, immense, incomprehensible, creator and lord). MISDIRECTED (3): thin existence targets a thick reading of esse (DISAMB-BEING), not the existence-to-act inclusion; the exceeded-god rival uses another sense of 'god' than GOD_4; the Hume/Moore motivation of the goodness rival concerns moral good, not GOOD_1. FORMAL ALTERNATIVE ONLY, no substantive objection identified (12): concrete population; contingent grounding (Hume I.3.3, claim HUME-TREATISE-I-3-3-NARROW-A, limits demonstrability only; the read Oppy 2020 paper makes the uncaused initial state necessary via shared initial history, claim OPPY-2020-SHARED-LAWS-INITIAL-HISTORY, so it does not supply a contingent brute root; Schmid's existential inertia, read, explains persistence by earlier existence and denies concurrent sustenance, not grounding, and its bearing on world-relative m.grounds is unresolved; the rival's paraphrase cites inertia as motivation, which this audit does not support); idle maximum; mere conservation; actuality without being; strong emergence; esse-essence difference without composition; world-soul; intellect without will; finite subsistent being (dispute lies upstream at STMT-ESSE-LIMITED-ONLY-THROUGH-RECEPTION); immutable without eternity; act and potency in one respect. Bare-negation rivals (will, infinity, eternity, sufficiency): no typed vocabulary added. For will, infinity and eternity no replacement account with independent justification is on file, so typing one would add a placeholder; for sufficiency the gap is the undefined field. WARRANT SIDE: no root or act-of-being premise is stated by a sourced claim; 12 of the 14 attribute premises are (Aquinas; Aristotle and Aquinas for the act-potency non-overlap), which attributes them and their reasons to a text without establishing them; every stage-two premise except sufficiency has at least one verified derivation, all from other open premises. No premise is established, refuted or changed; no rival is established.
blocker: Unread leads, to be read before any weight is given: Meinong, Ueber Gegenstandstheorie section 3 (candidate MEINONG-GEGENSTANDSTHEORIE-3); Broad 1925 ch. 2 (candidate BROAD-MIND-AND-ITS-PLACE-CH2); Scotus, Quaest. Metaph. IX q.14 (candidate SCOTUS-QQ-METAPH-IX-Q14) and Ordinatio I d.8 on the formal distinction; Aristotle Met. XII.7 (final cause only) and XII.9 (self-thinking first mover); Plotinus on necessary procession; Durandus on mere conservation; Spinoza, Ethics I; Shoemaker 1969, Time without change; Wolterstorff 1975, God everlasting; anti-privation accounts of evil; Kenny 2002 on esse ipsum subsistens. Next tests: type the Plotinian rival of STMT-IMMATERIAL-IS-INTELLECTUAL and test it jointly against the simplicity and intellect conclusions; state the ground-to-efficient-cause bridges that would let Welchance and Schaffer bear on whole-roster nontrapping and the uniting cause; define HasClassicalAttributes from Dei Filius ch. 1.
